cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Web Designer position for the Tendem project at Mindrift. With a solid background in web design, UI, and digital marketing, I am excited about the opportunity to create high-quality, conversion-driven web designs that align with your brand ecosystem.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in building and maintaining client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and Astra. I focus on responsive design, clear hierarchy, and strong typography to ensure that every page is both visually appealing and user-friendly. My work involves translating brand assets into structured web layouts, ensuring consistency across all touchpoints.

My personal project, mirook.com, is a testament to my design and technical capabilities. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site from scratch, implementing structured data and optimizing for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my ability to work independently, from concept to production-ready deliverables.

I am proficient in Figma, with experience in creating scalable layouts and design systems. I understand the importance of preparing files for seamless handoff to developers or no-code platforms like Webflow and Framer. My attention to detail ensures that spacing, responsiveness, and modern design trends are consistently applied.

I am particularly drawn to Mindrift's mission of combining real-world expertise with AI development. I am a self-directed professional with a conversion-minded approach, and I am eager to contribute to the Tendem project. My portfolio, available at mirook.com, showcases relevant web design cases.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, UI, and conversion-driven layouts. At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress, focusing on responsive design and user-centric structure. On my own project (mirook.com), I designed and built a multi-page site from scratch, implementing structured data and optimizing for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Skilled in Figma, no-code tools, and preparing production-ready files for developer handoff. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Web & UI Design: Figma, responsive web design, design systems, auto-layout, typography, white space, modern web trends
- Conversion-Driven Layouts: landing pages, one-pagers, marketing sites, clear hierarchy, user-centric approach
- Developer Handoff: organizing Figma frames, exporting assets, detailing specs, no-code platforms (Webflow, Framer)
- Cross-Platform Consistency: translating brand assets across web, social, and PDFs
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, WordPress site building, Elementor, Astra theme, Canva
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide design and content decisions

## Projects
